method: Actual production/HEAD renderer and fitter. Per-layer probes retain the same font, fit and stroke padding. Fill alpha>=128 and RGB>=150/150/140. Stroke thickness measures nearest bright-fill pixel-center distances for alpha>=128 outline pixels outside fill; raster distance, not vector width. Full alpha includes AA and stroke. Contrast uses actual active-material no-ink GPU background and straight-alpha compositing; no accessibility certification. Counter count/partial-alpha fraction are diagnostics, not perceptual scores. Bronze uses the disclosed warm-color predicate.
